notes.title: Nominate A MEMOIR BLUE in the 2022 Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Have you made your nominations for The Steam Awards yet? Please consider helping us out by nominating [i]A Memoir Blue[/i] in the "[b]Sit Back and Relax[/b]" category!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967085/2de857410c70396b129040c88d87a7c800c6cad3.png[/img]

Miriam might not look like she appreciates your support, but we do!

notes.title: Patch 1 - 2022/06/20
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have released our first patch to fix a few issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed a graphic issue in Chapter 6 regarding display errors when using the low graphic setting.
[*] Fixed a blocker in Chapter 5 during the dormitory scene.
[*] Fixed a blocker in Chapter 3 during the dock build interaction.
[*] Updated credits.
[/list]
Thanks for your patience and support!
-Kevin
